```{r}

data2 <- da04283.0002

```


Filter Dataset: 
```{r}
filtered_data1 <- data1 %>% 
  dplyr::select(STUDY_ID, T_IDEAP, T_IDEAK, CLS_SIZEPF, CLS_SIZEPS, CLS_SIZEKF, CLS_SIZEKS, CHGENP,CHRACE_AAP,CHRACE_ASP,CHRACE_LTP, CHRACE_NAP, CHINCOMCP, CHMATEDCP,CHRACE_WHP, PPVTEPF, PPVTEPS, PPVTEKF, PPVTEKS)

cleaned_data1 <- filtered_data1 %>%
  filter(across(c(T_IDEAP, T_IDEAK, CLS_SIZEPF,CLS_SIZEPS,CLS_SIZEKF,CLS_SIZEKS,PPVTEPF,PPVTEPS,PPVTEKF,PPVTEKS), ~!is.na(.)))
```

Standardize Scores:
```{r}
cleaned_data1 <- cleaned_data1 %>% 
    mutate(T_IDEAP = T_IDEAP/16)

```



Convert to Long:
```{r}

# Alternative approach for handling teacher attitudes
long_data <- cleaned_data1 %>%
  # First handle variables with 4 time points
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      # Class size variables
      CLS_SIZEPF, CLS_SIZEPS, CLS_SIZEKF, CLS_SIZEKS,
      # PPVT test score variables  
      PPVTEPF, PPVTEPS, PPVTEKF, PPVTEKS
    ),
    names_to = c(".value", "time_period"),
    names_pattern = "(CLS_SIZE|PPVTE)(PF|PS|KF|KS)"
  ) %>%
  # Then add teacher attitude based on the time period
  mutate(
    T_IDEA = case_when(
      time_period %in% c("PF", "PS") ~ T_IDEAP,
      time_period %in% c("KF", "KS") ~ T_IDEAK
    ),
    time = case_when(
      time_period == "PF" ~ 1,
      time_period == "PS" ~ 2,
      time_period == "KF" ~ 3,
      time_period == "KS" ~ 4
    ),
    period_label = case_when(
      time_period == "PF" ~ "Fall Pre-K",
      time_period == "PS" ~ "Spring Pre-K",
      time_period == "KF" ~ "Fall Kindergarten",
      time_period == "KS" ~ "Spring Kindergarten"
    )
  )

```

Panel Data Set up:
```{r}
panel_data <- pdata.frame(long_data, index = c("STUDY_ID", "time"))

summary(panel_data$PPVTE)
summary(panel_data$CLS_SIZE)
summary(panel_data$T_IDEA)

sum(complete.cases(panel_data[, c("PPVTE", "CLS_SIZE", "T_IDEA")]))
```


Clean Panel Data: 
```{r}
panel_data_clean <- panel_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(PPVTE), !is.na(CLS_SIZE), !is.na(T_IDEA))
```

Pooled OLS: 
```{r}
pooled_model <- plm(PPVTE ~ CLS_SIZE + T_IDEA +  CHGENP + CHRACE_AAP + CHRACE_ASP + CHRACE_LTP + CHRACE_NAP + CHINCOMCP + CHMATEDCP, 
                data = panel_data_clean,
                model = "pooling")




stargazer(pooled_model, type = 'text')
```



Fixed Effects: 
```{r}
#Fixed Effects
fe_model <- plm(PPVTE ~ CLS_SIZE + T_IDEA  +  CHGENP + CHRACE_AAP + CHRACE_ASP + CHRACE_LTP + CHRACE_NAP + CHINCOMCP + CHMATEDCP, 
                data = panel_data_clean, 
                model = "within")

#Individual Effects
fe_model_2 <- plm(PPVTE ~ CLS_SIZE + T_IDEA +  CHGENP + CHRACE_AAP + CHRACE_ASP + CHRACE_LTP + CHRACE_NAP + CHINCOMCP + CHMATEDCP, 
                data = panel_data_clean,
                model = "within",
                effect = "individual")

#Time Effects
fe_model_3 <- plm(PPVTE ~ CLS_SIZE + T_IDEA +  CHGENP + CHRACE_AAP + CHRACE_ASP + CHRACE_LTP + CHRACE_NAP + CHINCOMCP + CHMATEDCP, 
                data = panel_data_clean,
                model = "within",
                effect = "time")

stargazer(fe_model, type = 'text') #Fixed Effects
stargazer(fe_model_2, type = 'text') #Individual Effects
stargazer(fe_model_3, type = 'text') #Time Effects



bp_test <- bptest(fe_model)
print(bp_test)


model_robust <- coeftest(fe_model, vcov = vcovHC(fe_model, type = "HC0", sandwich = T))

print(model_robust)

stargazer(model_robust, type = 'text')


```




Two-Way Fixed Effects: 

```{r}
twoway_fe_model <- plm(PPVTE ~ CLS_SIZE + T_IDEA,
                        data = panel_data_clean,
                        model = "within",
                        effect = "twoways")

twoway_fe_model2 <- plm(PPVTE ~ CLS_SIZE + T_IDEA + factor(time),
                        data = panel_data_clean,
                        model = "within",
                        effect = "twoways")

stargazer(twoway_fe_model, type = 'text')
stargazer(twoway_fe_model2, type = 'text')

coeftest(twoway_fe_model, vcov = vcovHC(twoway_fe_model, type = "HC1"))


```




Random Effects: 
```{r}
re_model <- plm(PPVTE ~ CLS_SIZE + T_IDEA +  CHGENP + CHRACE_AAP + CHRACE_ASP + CHRACE_LTP + CHRACE_NAP + CHINCOMCP + CHMATEDCP, 
                data = panel_data_clean,
                model = "random")




stargazer(re_model, type = 'text')
```


Hausman Test: 
```{r}
hausman_test <- phtest(re_model, fe_model)
print(hausman_test)

```

Checking Individual R Squared:
```{r}
modelcheck <- lm(PPVTE ~ T_IDEA + factor(time) + factor(STUDY_ID), data = long_data)

stargazer(modelcheck, type = 'text')
```


DiD:
```{r}
did_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Create period indicator (0 = Pre-K, 1 = Kindergarten)
    period = ifelse(time_period %in% c("KF", "KS"), 1, 0),
    
    # You'll need a treatment indicator - this depends on your specific question
    # For example, if you're looking at progressive vs traditional teaching styles:
    treatment = ifelse(T_IDEA > median(T_IDEA, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0)
  )

# Run the DiD model
did_model <- plm(PPVTE ~ treatment + period + treatment:period, 
                data = pdata.frame(did_data, index = c("STUDY_ID", "time")),
                model = "pooling")  # Use pooling for standard DiD


did_model_2 <- plm(PPVTE ~ treatment + period + treatment:period, 
                data = pdata.frame(did_data, index = c("STUDY_ID", "time")),
                model = "within")  #  Two-way fixed effects DiD model

# View results
summary(did_model)

stargazer(did_model, type = 'text')

stargazer(did_model_2, type = "text")


median_test_score <- median(long_data$PPVTE, na.rm = TRUE)

print(median_test_score)

```



Another DiD:
```{r}
# Better approach would be:
did_data_2 <- long_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Treatment should be time-invariant (1 if ever treated)
    treated = ifelse(T_IDEA > median(T_IDEA, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),
    
    # Post period indicator
    post = ifelse(time_period %in% c("KF", "KS"), 1, 0)
  )

# DiD model with fixed effects
did_model3 <- plm(PPVTE ~ treated * post, 
                data = pdata.frame(did_data_2, index = c("STUDY_ID", "time_period")),
                model = "within")



# Or using lm with clustered SEs:
did_model <- lm(PPVTE ~ treated * post, data = did_data)
# Use coeftest with clustered standard errors
```


Parallel Trends: 
```{r}
# Create average outcome by time period and treatment group
trends_data <- did_data %>%
  # Assuming you've already defined your treatment variable
  group_by(time_period, treatment) %>%
  summarize(mean_PPVTE = mean(PPVTE, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Convert time_period to an ordered factor
trends_data <- trends_data %>%
  mutate(time_period = factor(time_period, levels = c("PF", "PS", "KF", "KS")))

# Plot pre-treatment and post-treatment periods
ggplot(trends_data, aes(x = time_period, y = mean_PPVTE, group = treatment, color = factor(treatment))) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2.5, linetype = "dashed") +  # Mark treatment timing between PS and KF
  labs(title = "Test Score Trends by Treatment Group",
       subtitle = "Vertical line indicates transition to treatment",
       x = "Time Period", 
       y = "Average PPVTE Score",
       color = "Treatment Group") +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}
panel_resid <- data.frame(
  fitted = fitted(fe_model),
  residuals = residuals(fe_model)
)

# Create residual plot
ggplot(panel_resid, aes(x = fitted, y = residuals)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted Values for Panel Model",
       x = "Fitted Values",
       y = "Residuals")



p1 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = CLS_SIZE, y = residuals)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Class Size vs Residuals",
       x = "Class Size", 
       y = "Residuals")

# 2. Teacher attitude vs residuals
p2 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = T_IDEA, y = residuals)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Teacher Attitude vs Residuals",
       x = "Teacher Attitude Score", 
       y = "Residuals")

# 3. Time period vs residuals
p3 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(time_period), y = residuals)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Time Period vs Residuals",
       x = "Time Period", 
       y = "Residuals")

# 4. For categorical variables (if any)
# Example for a categorical variable like student race
if("CHRACE_WHP" %in% colnames(plot_data)) {
  p4 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = factor(CHRACE_WHP), y = residuals)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "Student Race (White) vs Residuals",
         x = "White (1=Yes, 0=No)", 
         y = "Residuals")
}

# Display plots
grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 2)
```
